chunks: That is from the wisdom your Lord has revealed to you. So do not make another god with Allah, lest you be cast into Hell, reproved and ostracised.
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of making another god with Allah according to this verse?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited in Shia exegesis as a concise summary of the core tenets of Tawhid, links the reception of divine wisdom (Hikmah) directly to the practical avoidance of Shirk. It underscores the spiritual consequence of polytheism not merely as punishment, but as a state of being 'reproached' and 'repelled' from divine mercy, a concept elaborated upon in the context of the Prophet's unique status during the Isra and Mi'raj.
